def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_modes = [collections.Counter(row).most_common(1)[0][0] for row in grid]
    col_modes = [collections.Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(h)).most_common(1)[0][0] for c in range(w)]
    row_counts, col_counts = collections.Counter(row_modes), collections.Counter(col_modes)
    line_color = min(row_counts, key=lambda color: row_counts[color])
    line_color_c = min(col_counts, key=lambda color: col_counts[color])
    # Both stripe orientations use the same grid-line color.
    line_color = line_color_c if row_counts[line_color] == 0 else line_color
    rows = [r for r, color in enumerate(row_modes) if color == line_color]
    cols = [c for c, color in enumerate(col_modes) if color == line_color]
    if not rows or not cols:
        line_color = line_color_c
        rows = [r for r, color in enumerate(row_modes) if color == line_color]
        cols = [c for c, color in enumerate(col_modes) if color == line_color]
    nodes = [[grid[r][c] for c in cols] for r in rows]
    special_rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(nodes) if any(v != line_color for v in row)]
    special_cols = [j for j in range(len(cols)) if any(nodes[i][j] != line_color for i in range(len(rows)))]
    r0, r1 = min(special_rows), max(special_rows)
    c0, c1 = min(special_cols), max(special_cols)
    background = collections.Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[]
    for i in range(r0, r1):
        row=[]
        for j in range(c0, c1):
            block=[nodes[i][j], nodes[i+1][j], nodes[i][j+1], nodes[i+1][j+1]]
            row.append(block[0] if block.count(block[0]) == 4 and block[0] != line_color else background)
        out.append(row)
    return out

def parse_demo(text):
    m=re.search(r'Demo pair \d+ input \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n(.*?)\nDemo pair \d+ output \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n(.*?)(?:\n\nSame instance|\nWrong attempts)',text,re.S)
    if not m: raise ValueError('not matched')
    ih,iw,ib,oh,ow,ob=m.groups()
    inp=[[int(x) for x in row.split()] for row in ib.splitlines()]
    out=[[int(x) for x in row.split()] for row in ob.splitlines()]
    assert len(inp)==int(ih) and all(len(r)==int(iw) for r in inp), (len(inp),[len(r) for r in inp], ih,iw)
    assert len(out)==int(oh) and all(len(r)==int(ow) for r in out), (len(out),[len(r) for r in out],oh,ow)
    return inp,out

program = '''import collections


def transform(grid):
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_modes = [collections.Counter(row).most_common(1)[0][0] for row in grid]
    col_modes = [collections.Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(height)).most_common(1)[0][0]
                 for c in range(width)]
    row_mode_counts = collections.Counter(row_modes)
    col_mode_counts = collections.Counter(col_modes)
    line_color = min(row_mode_counts, key=row_mode_counts.get)
    line_color_by_column = min(col_mode_counts, key=col_mode_counts.get)
    rows = [r for r, color in enumerate(row_modes) if color == line_color]
    cols = [c for c, color in enumerate(col_modes) if color == line_color_by_column]

    nodes = [[grid[r][c] for c in cols] for r in rows]
    marked_rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(nodes)
                   if any(value != line_color for value in row)]
    marked_cols = [j for j in range(len(cols))
                   if any(nodes[i][j] != line_color for i in range(len(rows)))]
    r0, r1 = min(marked_rows), max(marked_rows)
    c0, c1 = min(marked_cols), max(marked_cols)
    background = collections.Counter(value for row in grid for value in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

    output = []
    for i in range(r0, r1):
        output_row = []
        for j in range(c0, c1):
            block = (nodes[i][j], nodes[i + 1][j],
                     nodes[i][j + 1], nodes[i + 1][j + 1])
            output_row.append(block[0] if block.count(block[0]) == 4 and block[0] != line_color
                              else background)
        output.append(output_row)
    return output
'''
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
p.write_text(program)
print(p, p.stat().st_size)
